theorem lg_target {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℤ_[p] E] [IsBoundedSMul ℤ_[p] E] [IsUltrametricDist E] (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  let M := f.cont_bounded.hBounded
  have h_bound : ∀ x : ℕ, ∥(fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0∥ ≤ M / p^x :=
    by
      intro x
      induction' x with n IH
      · simp [fwdDiff, funpow_zero]
        have h_0 : ∥(⇑f) 0∥ ≤ M := by apply f.isCont.mono (le_refl _) (le_refl _)
        exact le_div_of_le_mul_right h_0 (pow_pos p n)
      · simp [funpow_succ, fwdDiff, add_left_inj]
        let f1 := (fwdDiff 1)^[n] (⇑f)
        let f2 := (fwdDiff 1)^[n] (⇑f)
        have h_f1 : ∥f1 0∥ ≤ M / p^n := IH
        have h_f2 : ∥f2 1∥ ≤ M / p^n := IH
        have h_diff : ∥f1 0 - f2 1∥ ≤ ∥f1 0∥ + ∥f2 1∥ := by apply norm_add
        rw [add_right_inj, add_assoc]
        exact le_div_of_le_mul_right h_diff (pow_pos p n)
  have h_tendsto_1_over_p_x : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => 1 / p^x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    by
      apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_right
      · exact Filter.Tendsto.tendsto_atTop_one
      · exact Filter.Tendsto.tendsto_atTop_pow (Nat.Prime.toNat p).pos
  have h_epsilon_delta : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ x ≥ N, ∥(fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0∥ < ε :=
    by
      intros ε hε
      let ε' := ε / 1
      let N := ceil (log_p (M / ε'))
      let hN : N ≥ 0 := Nat.ceil_nonneg _
      let hN' : ∀ x ≥ N, p^x ≥ M / ε' :=
        by
          intro x
          have h : x ≥ N → p^x ≥ M / ε'
          · rw [Nat.ceil_def]
            have h_log : log_p (M / ε') = floor (log_p (M / ε')) + 1
              by exact Nat.log_p_floor_add_one (M / ε')
            have h_ineq : p^(floor (log_p (M / ε')) + 1) ≥ M / ε'
              by exact Nat.pow_le_pow_iff (M / ε') (p^(floor (log_p (M / ε')) + 1))
            exact Nat.pow_le_pow_iff (M / ε') (p^x) h_log
          exact h
      let h_bound_ε' : ∀ x ≥ N, ∥(fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0∥ ≤ M / p^x :=
        by intro x; apply h_bound
      let h_ineq : ∀ x ≥ N, M / p^x ≤ ε :=
        by intro x; apply le_div_of_le_mul_right (hN x) (pow_pos p x)
      let h_final : ∀ x ≥ N, ∥(fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0∥ < ε :=
        by intro x; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_bound_ε' x) (h_ineq x)
      exact ⟨N, h_final⟩
  exact Filter.Tendsto.of_le (fun x => ∥(fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0∥) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
